query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE slug = 'the-glass-menagerie') as project_id,
  t.id as tag_id,
  t.name as tag_name
FROM tags t
WHERE t.name IN ('Memory Play', 'Southern Gothic', '1930s');
